title: OneScan
creator: praise / Techkeyy
summary: November 26, 2026: OneScan compares published Ootle template bytes with public source rebuilds and displays verifier-key attestations. The current mainnet explorer shows its SourceRegistry component, template 5b0efecc709ce6885b69738ce8f774f086ef0c6cb7b2a58920f8bab3e38f8b13 and SourceAttested events. The creator reports eight matching third-party templates out of thirteen checked, with warnings on some builds; those rebuilds and security tests were not rerun. Source matching is not a code audit. The site explains that Windows rebuilds lack its Linux container isolation and that an attestation is a statement by its verifier key. Current README, public site text and explorer metadata were reviewed. The recording is a genuine README walkthrough with scripts and downloads disabled; no template binaries, repository code, wallet or verification jobs were executed.
cardSummary: Compare Ootle mainnet templates with public source rebuilds and inspect on-chain attestations, build settings and warnings.
